essence: The foremost twice-born must perform the fire-offering in a level site.
Bathing, the auspicious-thread rite, and bed-mounting must each be performed separately.
Remembering the form described by marks, one should worship the two deities.
After placing the tattvas, forms, and others, one should perform the fire-offering as before.
The rite uses parched rice, indraka, and the two trees named banyan and udumbara.
